itens.t: Russian drone strike kills at least 14 on Ukrainian rail platform
itens.r: A devastating Russian drone strike hit a crowded Ukrainian railway platform, killing at least 14 people and injuring numerous others. Emergency services rushed to the scene to extinguish fires and search the wreckage for survivors. The attack highlights the ongoing vulnerability of civilian infrastructure as the conflict deepens. International leaders have strongly condemned the strike on commuters.
itens.d:
A Russian drone strike has resulted in the deaths of at least fourteen individuals on a Ukrainian rail platform.

The attack on the railway location was reported by Reuters.

South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff confirmed the launches and condemned the provocative military action. Regional intelligence agencies are closely monitoring the situation for further missile tests.

itens.t: US economic growth accelerates in third quarter with 3.4% GDP expansion
itens.r: The United States economy grew at an annualized rate of 3.4% in the third quarter, surpassing expectations. Resilient consumer spending and artificial intelligence-driven business investments fueled the growth. This robust performance helps alleviate immediate concerns over an economic slowdown.
itens.d:
The economy of the United States expanded at an annualized rate of 3.4 percent in the third quarter, surpassing expectations due to resilient consumer spending and corporate investments driven by artificial intelligence. This growth helped offset pressures from higher oil prices related to conflicts in the Middle East.

The preliminary estimate was released by the Commerce Department's Bureau of Economic Analysis. Economists surveyed by Reuters had previously predicted a more modest GDP growth rate of 3.2 percent for the period.

The advanced space plane is designed to significantly increase flight frequency for future space tourists. This marks a major milestone in commercial suborbital flight development.

Virgin Galactic has officially unveiled Spaceship Apeiron, the first space plane in its new Delta-class vehicle line. The name, derived from the ancient Greek word for boundless, was chosen through a public vote involving thousands of participants across eighty-three countries and six continents.

The new spacecraft is scheduled to be flown from its manufacturing facility in Arizona to Spaceport America in New Mexico. There, it will undergo final preparations and avionics software work before beginning its upcoming flight tests and operational missions.

The breakthrough promises to reshape how computer systems approach complex problem-solving.

With this stellar scoring output, the 38-year-old guard equaled a notable longevity record held by LeBron James. Curry continues to defy age with elite shooting and playmaking.
itens.d:
Stephen Curry scored 44 points to lead the Golden State Warriors to a 119-114 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves in Minneapolis. This performance marked the 15th time the 38-year-old guard has scored 40 or more points after turning 35.

With this achievement, Curry tied a long-standing NBA longevity record previously held exclusively by LeBron James. Curry also contributed eight rebounds and six assists during the game.

itens.t: Laser mapping reveals pre-Columbian planned Amazonian cities connected by roads
itens.r: Advanced LiDAR laser mapping over the Amazon rainforest has uncovered ancient urban settlements linked by broad roads extending up to two kilometers. The discovery proves that pre-European indigenous societies engaged in large-scale, planned regional organization. Archaeologists say the findings fundamentally alter our understanding of early Amazonian habitation.
itens.d:
Archaeological research utilizing LiDAR laser mapping technology has revealed extensive pre-Columbian urban settlements hidden beneath the vegetation in the Amazon rainforest. Discovered in the Upano Valley of Ecuador, these sites date back approximately 2,500 years and feature numerous earth platforms and organized residential areas.

The study, led by French archaeologist Stéphen Rostain and published in Science, highlights a sophisticated network of wide, straight roads connecting various communities. These findings demonstrate that complex urban planning existed in the region long before the arrival of Europeans.

Measuring between 600 and 1,500 kilometers in diameter, the object is a strong candidate for dwarf planet classification. Researchers are currently verifying its precise orbital characteristics.
